integrity: The proof writes every outside multiset representation as an exact distance-count triple, derives a five-vertex upper bound on the complement of any resolving set, constructs a sharp complement of size five, and then classifies equality by the omitted-spine pattern. A standalone verifier independently recomputes graph distances and checks all smaller sets and all bases in the tested range.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to square-page book graphs B_r with r at least three.
The two-page book B_2 is exceptional and is not included.
Triangular books, longer-cycle books, and arbitrary generalized theta graphs are not covered.
Finite exhaustive verification over 3 <= r <= 9 is corroborative only; the all-r theorem follows from the signature proof.
Search coverage cannot exclude a differently named or non-indexed exact treatment.
title: Outer multiset bases of square-page book graphs
